home.title: Meet the people around you
home.scanPrompt: Scan the QR code on your table to get started.

landing.subtitle: See who's here and say hello, anonymously.

VENUE_NOT_FOUND.title: This QR code is not active
VENUE_NOT_FOUND.body: It may be old or not set up yet. Please ask the staff.

location.outside: You don't seem to be at {{venue}}
location.outsideHelp: This chat only works inside the restaurant. If you are inside, move a little further in and try again.
location.unknown: We couldn't get a precise location
location.unknownHelp: Move near a window or turn on Precise Location for your browser, then try again.
location.deniedHelp: We use your location only to check you're inside. It is never shown to anyone. Turn it on in your browser settings.
location.whyBody: IntroChat works only inside {{venue}}. We use your location once, just to check that. It is never shown to anyone.
location.unsupported: This browser can't share your location
location.unsupportedHelp: Open this page in Chrome or Safari. If it opened inside another app, use its "Open in browser" option.

people.empty: No one else is here yet. Check back in a few minutes.

chats.empty: No chats yet. Say hi to someone from People.
chats.selectPrompt: Pick a chat on the left, or say hi to someone from People.

chat.readOnly: {{handle}} has left. You can still read and report this chat.

session.warningBody: Your session ends soon. Want more time?
session.finalBody_one: Choose an option within {{count}} second, or you'll be logged out.
session.finalBody_other: Choose an option within {{count}} seconds, or you'll be logged out.
session.away: You seem to be outside {{venue}}. Come back within {{time}} or your session will end.
session.offline: No connection. Your session continues; reconnect to keep chatting.

ended.title: Your session has ended

reasons.venue_closed: The restaurant has closed for today.

ended.chatsDeleted: Your chats from this visit have been deleted.
ended.scanAgain: Scan the QR code on your table to start again.

mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for IntroChat.

notAdmin.title: No admin access
notAdmin.body: {{email}} is not an IntroChat admin. Ask an existing admin to give you access.

venues.empty: No venues yet. Create the first one.

venue.name: Name
venue.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Part of every QR link of this venue.

pin.title: Location pin
pin.noResults: No places found. Try a shorter search, or drag the pin.
pin.dragHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to move it.
pin.fromPhoneHelp: At the venue: stand in the middle of the seating area and keep the phone still.

test.title: On-site test
test.help: Walk around with this phone: to each table, the door and outside. You see live what a guest standing here would get.

states.inside: INSIDE: a guest here can join

tables.label: Table name

push.askBody: Even when IntroChat is closed. Notifications never show what anyone wrote.
push.installBody: Notifications work once IntroChat is on your Home Screen:
push.installStep1: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari.
push.installStep3: Open IntroChat from your Home Screen and scan your table again.
